title: Cloud Nurdz Watermelon Apple Ice Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Cloud Nurdz Shortfill Ice Watermelon Apple E-liquid combines the juicy sweetness of watermelon with the crisp taste of apple and a refreshing ice finish for a vibrant and fruity vape experience. This balanced blend ensures a satisfying flavour profile that is both sweet and crisp, with an added coolness, ideal for those who enjoy refreshing fruit combinations with a twist. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite flavours can last and last, and comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of up to two nicotine shots to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Cloud Nurdz Shortfills are mixed with a 50VG/50PG ratio which makes them ideal for use with a vast array of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits and tanks, including starter kits and low-powered pod kits. The 50/50 formula provides a pitch-perfect balance of flavour, vapour production and a smooth yet tactile throat hit. Cloud Nurdz 50/50 shortfills are NOT suitable for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Founded in 2016 by two vaping enthusiasts, US vape juice brand Cloud Nurdz is celebrated for its astonishing e-liquid flavours. Their dedication to creating unique and satisfying vape experiences has earned them a loyal following worldwide. Discover the bold flavours of Cloud Nurdz shortfills at Vapestore today.
